svg.title: B1-XGB′+aug: top-1 confusions at 25% evidence
svg.desc: Each row is the patients of one true condition; each column, the condition ranked first. AoD, aortic dissection, has no DDXPlus patient, so it is a column only. * must-not-miss. Validation split, 33,963 patients. DDXPlus is synthetic, so these figures describe its generator, not real patients. Closed world: only 13 conditions can be named (R-13). Evidence masked by docs/05 §3.7 (digests e99a7a8fbf792675 / af3a357f6454838a): the same patients at every level, each 25% history inside its 50% one; the masks remove answers at random, which a clinician's questions do not. The component alone, not fused. EXP-023.
